source.check: names and divisions read from the News-Letter's printed list of unopposed Unionist nominations, 24 April 1924

note: Reconstitution of Lisnaskea rural district council. Twenty-two Unionist candidates were nominated for the thirty-one divisions and, there being no Nationalist nominations, were returned unopposed; no nominations were received for Aghakillymaude, Eshnadaaragh, Carnmore, Drummully, Springtown, Derrysteaton, Kilmore, Armagh Manor or Drumshimuck (Belfast News-Letter, 24 April 1924). Unopposed Unionist nomination. Returned unopposed.
